intro: Professionals and everyday users convert pounds (lb) to us short tons (ton (US)) when working across imperial and us_customary standards in engineering specifications, international trade documentation, and technical measurements. One pound (avoirdupois) equals 0.0005 us short tons, while 1 us short ton equals 2,000 pounds. Whether you are verifying mass & weight specifications on imported equipment, cross-checking technical datasheets, or scaling practical measurements, this converter applies the exact NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 reference relationship with instant precision.

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: Short Ton (US) vs. Metric Tonne (t) vs. Long Ton (UK)
items: Three distinct units are called a "ton": the US Short Ton equals 2,000 lbs (907.185 kg), the Metric Tonne (t) equals 1,000 kg (2,204.62 lbs), and the British Imperial Long Ton equals 2,240 lbs (1,016.05 kg).
Confusing US short tons with metric tonnes introduces a 10.2% freight weight error on international bills of lading.

faqs.question: How many us short tons (ton (US)) are in 1 pound (avoirdupois) (lb)?
faqs.answer: There are 0.0005 us short tons (ton (US)) in 1 pound (avoirdupois) (lb), which rounds to 0.0005 ton (US) for everyday calculations. Conversely, 1 us short ton equals 2,000 pounds.

faqs.question: How do I convert pounds to us short tons (lb to ton (US))?
faqs.answer: To convert pounds to us short tons, use the formula: ton (US) = lb × 0.0005. For example, converting 25 lb gives 0.0125 ton (US).

faqs.question: What is 25 pounds in us short tons?
faqs.answer: 25 pounds (lb) equals exactly 0.0125 us short tons (ton (US)) using standard NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 conversion factors.
